g.text: 7 timed reference files, all by one editor; cached Voxtral tokens regrouped, machine-independent.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: The default gap_s 1.2 is kept although lower values score higher, because all seven references share one editor's convention,

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: and lower gap_s gains partly by emitting more cues (right panel). Source: cue-layout.md.
